finding.claim: Request framing is not reconciled: TE is stripped for upstream and Content-Length is not re-added for unmodified StreamBuffer bodies, and TE+CL requests are not rejected. Pre-read body bytes are still forwarded, so the upstream may receive body bytes without a framing header. Impact (desync vs. error) depends on Pingora's HTTP/1.1 request writer, which is not in this tree. UNVERIFIED.
finding.source: Client request with Transfer-Encoding: chunked, or with both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length, on a route whose pipeline has a read-only StreamBuffer request-body filter
finding.sink: Upstream HTTP/1.1 request framing (Pingora writer, not in tree) with body bytes from ctx.pre_read_body
